Latin Small Letter K Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Small Letter K is 107. Hold Alt, type 107 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Small Letter K also has the Unicode codepoint U+006B, so you can type it with Alt+107 on Windows, search for U+006B in macOS's Character Viewer, use k in HTML, or \006B in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Small Letter K character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. Latin Small Letter K has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape k or the hex escape k.

How to type latin small letter k on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 0 7 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Small Letter K character (k) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin small letter k on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Small Letter K. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Small Letter K" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin small letter k in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\006B"; ()
  • Python: \u006B or chr(0x6B)
  • JavaScript: \u006B or String.fromCodePoint(0x6B)
  • JSON: "\u006B"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Small Letter K?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Small Letter K is 107. Hold Alt, type 1 0 7 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type k without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as k, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+107 not work?

Alt+107 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Small Letter K?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Small Letter K is U+006B. You can use this value in HTML as k, in CSS as \006B, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type k on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+006B, then click it.
